# DR-1282: The name and the proof (wm10) — crossing the counter, and the difference between a verified attribution and a verified claim

**Date:** 2026-10-29
**Status:** Accepted
**Tier:** A (additive curriculum: one new World Market module with its own pinned gate; the course's `meta.weeks` and `meta.format` follow its own module count; two generated files re-derived by their own scripts; a new row in `lesson-sources.json` whose figures a GitHub runner read back, raising `CHECKED_LESSONS` 2 → 3 while the counted honesty gap does NOT move)
**Type:** curriculum
**Area:** Learn · Stock Market department · The World Market: Countries That Trade (`app/src/lib/world-market-course.js`)
**Sent in by:** Darrell, Gmail thread `1a11be244e5f5452` — a Retail Dive newsletter of 8 October 2026, "Consumer behavior is changing. Are you ready?", forwarded to himself with one word at the top of the body: **"Lessons"**. That word is the whole of the request, and it had been waiting three weeks.
**Pairs with:** DR-0312 (the forwarded-teaching intake), DR-0610 (the capture lock), DR-1126 (the third pile is a worklist, and it is counted), DR-1146 / DR-1275 / DR-1276 / DR-1278 (the four prior digest-built lessons and the two branches their disclosures took), DR-0108 (the team's reach, not one agent's), DR-0750 (the sources witness), DR-0076 (§1 evidence, §3 proven-to-catch, §4 measure don't claim, §7 independent verification, §8 provenance and honest uncertainty), DR-0100 (established fact plainly; the open flagged narrowly), DR-0098 (teach the Word, do not debate it), DR-0210 / DR-0076 bright line (Yahweh in our voice, never substituted into a quotation), DR-0459 (never an elision), DR-0733 / DR-0795 (every band sends the reader all three ways), DR-0734 (`anchor.ref` names every verse the lesson stands on), DR-0239 (a surface says true things), DR-0075 (perpetual improvement), DR-1021 (the renumber by hand)

## Context

The World Market had nine lessons. Eight built the machinery and gave the rule — why anybody trades at all, what a currency is, why a trade deficit is not a debt, what still has to be dug and shipped, what a central bank can and cannot do, the reserve question, what closing the pipes costs, and the just weight that does not stop being required at a border. The ninth (wm9, DR-1276) took the whole of it to one front door and accounted for one winter heating bill.

**All nine stood the reader on the same side of the counter.** The family that needed corn in Egypt; the household that could not stop buying heat in January. Every lesson taught the reader as a BUYER, and not one of them ever asked what the name on the other side of the transaction was worth, or how a buyer checks it. That is a hole in the argument rather than a missing application, and it is the hole a reader falls into the moment he leaves the course and has to decide whether to believe a seller.

The forward supplied exactly that question, and supplied it in a form that is itself the lesson.

## What was measured

**The source, and its exact standing — which is thinner than a lesson usually admits.** The email is, in its entirety, a **sponsor placement**. There is no Retail Dive reporting in it at all: "This week's Retail Dive brought to you by" across the top, a Kearney banner, four separate links to the same report, a Chicago street address, four social icons, a media-kit pitch and an unsubscribe footer. Not one line of journalism. Darrell's standing rule is that advertising is **ignored entirely unless the advertisement is itself germane**, and in the ordinary case that rule closes the matter and no lesson exists.

**It is germane, and the reason IS the teaching.** What the advertisement sells is a report about **trust** — the claim that trust is moving away from a brand's name and toward what a product can be shown to do. That claim arrived inside an advertisement, and an advertisement is, structurally, a name asking to be believed. The material and the envelope assert the same thing from opposite sides. The lesson is careful that this is **structural and not moral**: it says in its own text that nothing here accuses Kearney of dishonesty and nothing here knows whether it is honest, and that the objection is only that a name praising itself is the one form of evidence that cannot settle the question it raises (Proverbs 27:2).

**The germane content is three claims and a study size, and that is all of it.** The email reports a global study of **21,500 consumers** by the Kearney Consumer Institute, and from it: **$20 trillion** in spending could become contestable as trust shifts from brand name to proven performance; **86 percent** of consumers care more about whether something works than about the brand behind it; and automation will free up an **additional 80 minutes a day**. Nothing else in the email is germane and nothing else is taught.

**THE ROAD WAS WALKED, NOT ASSUMED SHUT (DR-0108), AND IT CHANGED THE OUTCOME.** wm9 could point `lesson-sources.json` at nothing because its figures arrived inside an email and an email is not a publisher's page. This email is a **sponsor placement**, and a sponsor's entire purpose is to send the reader to the sponsor's own page — so the publisher page exists, is named in the email, and a runner reaches it. Measured: this cloud sandbox cannot reach `www.kearney.com` at all (the agent proxy answers **403 to the CONNECT** by policy, the same shape DR-1146 recorded for `slack.engineering`), and a **GitHub runner read the page in under two seconds**.

**Two probe runs on a throwaway branch found what no amount of reasoning would have.** Runs **40791955446** and **40792095572**:

- The page says **"86 percent"**, NOT the email's **"86%"**.
- The page carries neither **"proven performance"** nor **"up for grabs"** as strings — both are the email's own copy, not the publisher's.
- The page does carry **"21,500 consumers"**, **"$20 trillion in"**, **"whether something works"**, **"brand name"** and **"contestable"** in its own text.
- The email's **"80 minutes a day"** and **"additional 80 minutes"** are **absent from the page entirely**.

So wm10 takes the **FIRST branch** `the-third-pile-is-a-worklist` offers, on its first commit: five figures gain a row in `lesson-sources.json` and are read back from the publisher's own page. `CHECKED_LESSONS` rises **2 → 3**. **The GAP does not move** — it stays 13 — because wm10 arrived carrying disclosures and left the gap untouched in the same change, gaining a source row rather than an apology (the same shape DR-1275 recorded for legacy8 a day earlier).

**AND THE LESSON TEACHES THE LIMIT OF ITS OWN ROW, which is the whole point and the reason this record is not simply a win.** A green read-back invites a lesson to imply its claim was verified. **It was not.** A read-back proves **ATTRIBUTION**: the publisher asserts the figure on its own page. It establishes nothing about whether the study is methodologically sound, whether 21,500 people were in fact surveyed, what question produced that 86, or whether a quantity the size of $20 trillion carries a meaning anyone can act on — **and here the publisher is also the party selling the report, so the witness is the seller.** The lesson says it in one sentence that occurs exactly once in the adult text and once in each of the four bands: *we asked the name whether the name said it, and we did not test the works.* That distinction is the sharper tool wm9 could not reach, and it is this lesson's spine.

**WHAT NOBODY HERE VERIFIED, stated plainly (DR-0076 §8) and carried on every reader-facing surface.** The report itself was never read — it is sold rather than given. The study's method, sample and question wording are unknown here. The 80-minutes claim did not read back and stands as the email's claim and nothing further. All four bands and the adult text say each of these, and the pinned gate makes every one of them non-removable with a strip proof.

**The three tiers (DR-0100).** ESTABLISHED, with no hedge near it, and taught from the Word rather than from the report: a name is real property and worth having (Proverbs 22:1; Ecclesiastes 7:1), AND a name does not certify itself (Proverbs 27:2; Revelation 3:1). Both halves, in one breath — a reader taught only the second becomes unable to receive what a lifetime of faithfulness produces, which is a loss wearing the clothes of sophistication, and a reader taught only the first is defenceless. OPEN, narrowly: whether the Kearney study is sound, and what the 80 minutes figure rests on. NOT smeared into a blanket doubt about the subject — and specifically NOT turned into a verdict on Kearney, which the lesson refuses in its own text and a gate refuses in every string.

**The Word, which had the rule first, and the spine was chosen for the GAP it fills rather than by theme.** Lesson eight put the just weight in the seller's hand (Leviticus 19:36). This lesson notices the buyer has one too, which no lesson in the course had said: *"It is naught, it is naught, saith the buyer: but when he is gone his way, then he boasteth"* (Proverbs 20:14) — he talks the article down while bargaining and boasts of the bargain once clear of the shop, which is a false weight in the buyer's own hand, and *"Divers weights, and divers measures, both of them are alike abomination to the LORD"* (Proverbs 20:10) — **both** of them. The test is the fruit (Matthew 7:16), stated as a law rather than a suggestion; James makes it a challenge with no remainder (James 2:18); the proving is **commanded, and so is the holding** — *"Prove all things; hold fast that which is good"* (1 Thessalonians 5:21), which is the clause that keeps the lesson from curdling into cynicism; the outward is named as the wrong instrument (1 Samuel 16:7); and the scale a household can actually operate is the small thing (Luke 16:10). The freed-time claim is answered by *"Redeeming the time, because the days are evil"* (Ephesians 5:16) — the question no advertisement asks is what the minutes are FOR. We hold ourselves to the same measure (2 Corinthians 8:21), which is why the lesson shows its working in public. And one Name answers the test exactly: Jesus, the Lamb of Yahweh and the Eternal Son of Yahweh (John 1:29; John 3:16), who did not send a claim ahead of Himself but came and did the work.

**The lesson, measured on the module rather than claimed.** Adult prose **1,996 words**; band shares **child 0.55 / youth 0.69 / teen 0.91 / senior 1.04** against floors 0.50 / 0.60 / 0.60 / 0.60; reading ladder **0.8 / 6.5 / 8.1 / 11.4**, strictly ascending with the child band far under the 5.0 new-lesson ceiling; worst band-pair overlap **0.26** against a ceiling of 0.50; **105 referenced quoted spans, 105 verbatim off the corpus on disk, 0 faults**; **21 anchors**, every one named in the adult lesson and every quoted reference covered by `anchor.ref`, both directions exact; the title named in all four band openings; no ellipsis inside any quotation; no decision-record id and no Gmail thread id anywhere a reader can see; no generic "God" or "LORD" in our voice, while the KJV's own "God" and "the LORD" are untouched inside every quotation. **Two parables**, both deliberately not testimonies.

**`allFour` rises 267 → 268** with total 441 → 442; the world-market row moves from `{lessons: 9, allFour: 9}` to `{lessons: 10, allFour: 10}`; `adultOnly` and `adultRegister` both stay 0. Regenerated by `scripts/course-band-baseline-write.mjs`, never hand-written — three PRs the previous night each hand-wrote this number and two were wrong.

**THE GATE AND THE MEASUREMENTS FOUND FIVE THINGS THE AUTHOR DID NOT.** Recorded because a record listing only what went right is the theatre DR-0076 forbids.

1. **The CHILD band was short at 0.47** against its 0.50 floor on the first measurement, because the adult lesson had grown to 1,996 prose words. Fixed the right way round: the child band gained the three concrete actions and the "we never read the report, it is not free" disclosure it was genuinely missing, rather than adult teaching being cut to flatter a ratio.
2. **The child band named no publication at all.** Every other band named Retail Dive and the date; the child band said only "Darrell got an email". A reader of that one band met four figures with no provenance whatever. Found by counting the provenance strings across all five places rather than by reading.
3. **The firm was named nowhere in the lesson.** The first draft said "a consulting firm" throughout, on the reasoning that naming it would read as a verdict. That was wrong on provenance (DR-0076 §8): a reader cannot check a figure whose publisher is withheld, and naming who published a study is attribution, not an accusation. Kearney is now named in the adult text and in all four bands, and the lesson's own "this is structural, not moral" sentence plus a gate over every string carry the protection instead.
4. **A PIN THAT WOULD HAVE PROVED NOTHING, found by counting before trusting.** Every figure in this lesson occurs **TWICE** in each adult-register band — once where the claim is stated and again in the list of what read back. Pinning "86 percent" or "21,500 consumers" to prove a disclosure exists would have passed with the disclosure deleted. This is precisely the trap DR-1275 hit with `367,000` and DR-1278 hit with `Mitch Berk`, and it was avoided rather than survived: all five disclosure signals were counted across all five places first, each occurs **exactly once**, and the test asserts that uniqueness in its own right so a future edit cannot quietly make a pin ambiguous.
5. **The course's own care note was ALREADY FALSE on main, and this lesson made it worse.** `WORLD_MARKET_CARE_NOTE` promised the course "quotes no figure" — a promise wm9 broke when it landed hours earlier with `$5.26 a gallon`, and that nobody corrected. A surface saying an untrue thing about itself is a DR-0239 defect, and it is fixed here rather than left for a later session: the note now says the course quotes no figure **as current**, that where the last two lessons carry figures they are a dated attributed reading, and that each says which of its numbers read back off a publisher's page and which did not.

## Decision

Ship wm10 as the tenth module of The World Market, with all four age bands from its first commit, its own pinned gate, a real row in `lesson-sources.json` whose five figures a GitHub runner read back from the publisher's own page, and — more important than the row — the lesson's own statement of what that row does and does not prove. Raise `CHECKED_LESSONS` 2 → 3 and leave `GAP` at 13. Correct `WORLD_MARKET_CARE_NOTE`, which was already inaccurate before this lesson existed.

Checked rather than assumed, because wm8 had to be reworded when wm9 made "the last lesson" untrue.

## Verification

- **Scripture:** 105 referenced quoted spans across the adult text and four bands, **105 verbatim** against the corpus on disk, **0 faults**. The spine is pinned by literal text read off the corpus before it was written, never produced by the same resolver the sweep uses — a witness that shares the thing it is witnessing is not a witness. `Proverbs 20:14` is why: the KJV reads *"but when he is gone his way"* and memory supplies *"and when he is gone his way"*.
- **Proven-to-catch, on the real artifact and not only on an in-test fixture (DR-0076 §3):** an altered word inside Revelation 3:1; a straight apostrophe where Ecclesiastes 7:1 carries the typographic one; the attribution-limit disclosure stripped from one band alone, which must name that band while the unbroken article still reads green; one band's friend line removed, which must name that band while `hasAllThree(module)` stays green; a story's `kind` flipped to `testimony`; and an anchor reference the lesson never names.
- **A fabricated story is never labelled true.** Both stories are `kind: 'parable'`, written in the third person. This lesson is built from an advertisement: nobody's life is in it and nobody here holds a narrator or a consent, so `testimony` — which renders to the reader as a true story told with the person's consent — would be the exact false claim that gate exists to stop. The gate asserts both parables, refuses `testimony`, and refuses a first-person narrator, which would be a testimony wearing the other label.
- **The witness:** `lesson-sources-witness.yml` runs on a push to `lesson-sources.json`, so this row is read back on the branch. The two probe runs are **40791955446** and **40792095572**; the probe branch was deleted after it had answered.
- **The row and the lesson cannot drift apart:** the gate asserts every `says` string in the row is still carried by the lesson, so a future edit cannot leave the witness reading back a figure the lesson no longer states.
- `re-review: 2026-11-29` — the three figures that read back are attribution only, and that is a permanent limit of this road rather than a gap to close: the study itself is not published, so no runner can test the method. What IS owed and dated: if the Kearney report becomes readable without purchase, read what it actually says about the 21,500-person sample and the question that produced the 86, and either teach it or say that it is still not available. If the "80 minutes" claim appears on a publisher page by then, add it to the row and drop the clause that says it did not read back.

## A note on the number

**This record is DR-1282, not the DR-1280 the build was told to take, and the correction was measured rather than reasoned.** The instruction said main's pointer read DR-1279 because bank9 held it in an open PR, and that DR-1281 was taken by a sibling builder in management-stewardship. Two of those three facts had moved by the time this branch started, and `scripts/claim-decision-number.mjs` plus two `git ls-tree` reads against the real refs settled it:

- **DR-1279 has LANDED on `origin/main`** as `DR-1279-the-moat-that-moves-bank9.md`. It is not in flight; bank9 merged.
- **DR-1280 is genuinely taken, by a PUSHED branch** — `origin/money/phase-2-safe-to-spend` carries `DR-1280-money-opens-on-safe-to-spend.md`. Taking it would have collided with a branch anyone can see, which is the DR-1021 renumber this house has now recorded nineteen times in a week.
- **DR-1281** is free on disk and free among pushed branches, and the instruction says a sibling builder holds it in management-stewardship. An unpushed sibling is invisible to every tool that reads the repo — exactly the condition `INDEX.md`'s own pointer note describes — so the tool's "DR-1281 is free" is a statement about what a file can know, not about what is true.

So DR-1282 is the first number free against **both** witnesses: the measured one and the reported one. The premise was surfaced before the irreversible step rather than cleaned up after a collision, and the build was not stopped for it.
